title: 高層建築調諧質量阻尼器~Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings
focus: 以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內~Mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits
summary: 從超高層的橫風向渦流振動與居住舒適度出發，建立主結構模態與擺錘的雙自由度模型，依 Den Hartog 準則決定調頻與阻尼，再處理數百公噸質量塊的吊裝、現場調頻、阻尼器試驗、行程限制與長期監測，最後以台北 101 與上海中心大廈的實例比較油壓與渦電流兩種耗能方式。~Starting from across-wind vortex shedding and occupant comfort in supertall towers, build a two-degree-of-freedom model of the building mode and pendulum, set tuning and damping with the Den Hartog criteria, then handle the erection of a mass of several hundred tonnes, on-site tuning, damper testing, stroke limits and long-term monitoring, comparing hydraulic and eddy-current dissipation through Taipei 101 and Shanghai Tower.

units.title: 風致振動與居住舒適度~Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort
units.mechanism: 超高層建築的第一模態頻率常低於 0.2 Hz，風吹過方形或圓角斷面時，背風側交替脫落的渦流會產生垂直於風向的週期性橫風力；當渦流脫落頻率接近結構頻率時，橫風向振動被共振放大，通常比順風向擺動更大。這種擺動很少威脅強度，卻會讓高樓層的人感到暈眩、看到吊燈搖晃或聽到帷幕牆摩擦聲，因此設計目標常以「回歸期內頂層尖峰加速度」表示，而不是位移。~The first-mode frequency of a supertall tower is often below 0.2 Hz. As wind flows past a square or rounded section, vortices shed alternately on the leeward side and produce a periodic across-wind force; when the shedding frequency approaches the structural frequency, across-wind motion is amplified by resonance and usually exceeds along-wind sway. This motion rarely threatens strength, but upper-floor occupants feel queasy, see pendant lights swing or hear façade joints creak, so the design target is usually a peak top-floor acceleration for a given return period rather than a displacement.
units.model: 渦流脫落頻率 f_s = St·U/B。取方形斷面 St ≈ 0.12、寬度 B = 50 m、結構頻率 f₁ = 0.14 Hz，臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St = 0.14×50/0.12 ≈ 58 m/s；若改為斜角或退縮斷面使 St 分散，共振不再集中在單一風速。數值為教學假設。~Vortex-shedding frequency f_s = St·U/B. With a square-section St ≈ 0.12, width B = 50 m and structural frequency f₁ = 0.14 Hz, the critical wind speed is U_cr = f₁·B/St = 0.14×50/0.12 ≈ 58 m/s; chamfered or tapered sections spread St so resonance no longer locks onto one wind speed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比對風洞高頻力平衡（HFFB）或氣動彈性模型試驗得到的橫風向力頻譜與本步估算的臨界風速，並把試驗換算到實尺度的頂層加速度，與居住性準則（例如以半年或一年回歸期計的尖峰加速度限值）逐一比較。~Compare the across-wind force spectrum from a high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) or aeroelastic wind-tunnel test with the critical wind speed estimated here, scale the test to full-size top-floor acceleration, and check it against habitability criteria such as peak-acceleration limits for a half-year or one-year return period.
units.failure: 若只做順風向靜力設計而忽略橫風向共振，結構強度合格，但完工後在中等強風就出現明顯擺動與住戶抱怨，事後才補裝阻尼器時，樓層空間、承載與吊裝路徑都已受限。~Designing only for along-wind static load and ignoring across-wind resonance passes strength checks, yet after completion moderate winds cause noticeable sway and complaints; retrofitting a damper then finds floor space, load capacity and lifting routes already constrained.
units.misconception: 超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。~Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened.
units.practice: 設計階段就要在頂部機械層預留阻尼器的空間、樓板承載與維修動線，並在風洞報告中要求同時提供有無阻尼器兩種情境的加速度預測，作為業主決策依據。~Reserve damper space, slab capacity and maintenance access in the top mechanical levels from the design stage, and require the wind-tunnel report to predict accelerations both with and without a damper so the owner can decide.

units.anchor: 第一彎曲模態~First bending mode
units.title: 模態質量與雙自由度模型~Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model
units.mechanism: 調諧質量阻尼器只對準一個模態，因此先把建築在該模態下簡化為等效單自由度系統：等效質量是以阻尼器所在位置的模態位移正規化後的廣義質量，而不是整棟樓的總重。阻尼器質量除以這個廣義質量就是質量比 μ，它決定了阻尼器能提供的最大附加阻尼；把擺錘與主結構串成雙自由度系統後，原本單一共振峰會分裂成兩個較低的峰。~A tuned mass damper targets a single mode, so the building is first reduced to an equivalent single-degree-of-freedom system for that mode. Its equivalent mass is the generalised mass normalised to the modal displacement at the damper location, not the total building weight. Damper mass divided by this generalised mass is the mass ratio μ, which bounds the added damping the device can supply; coupling the pendulum to the structure as a two-degree-of-freedom system splits the single resonance peak into two lower peaks.
units.model: 均勻懸臂第一模態以頂端位移正規化時，廣義質量約為總質量的 0.25。若參與擺動的質量取 400,000 t，M* ≈ 0.25×400,000 = 100,000 t；阻尼器 660 t 時 μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066。數值為教學假設。~For a uniform cantilever normalised to tip displacement, the first-mode generalised mass is about 0.25 of the total mass. Taking 400,000 t of participating mass gives M* ≈ 0.25×400,000 = 100,000 t; a 660 t damper then gives μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 用有限元素模型取出阻尼器所在樓層的模態向量與廣義質量，與手算懸臂近似比較；再以雙自由度模型掃頻，確認加裝阻尼器後的頻率響應出現兩個峰且峰值低於無阻尼器時。~Extract the modal vector and generalised mass at the damper floor from the finite-element model and compare with the hand cantilever estimate; then sweep the two-degree-of-freedom model to confirm that the response with the damper shows two peaks lower than the undamped peak.
units.failure: 把整棟樓的總質量當成分母，會把質量比低估數倍，導致阻尼器設計過小；反之若把阻尼器放在模態位移小的樓層，等效質量變大，同一顆質量塊的效果大打折扣。~Using total building mass as the denominator underestimates the mass ratio several-fold and undersizes the damper; conversely, placing the damper where the modal displacement is small inflates the equivalent mass and sharply reduces the benefit of the same block.
units.misconception: 阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。~A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight.
units.practice: 阻尼器通常放在接近頂部、模態位移最大的樓層；若主要問題是第二模態或扭轉，需另行評估位置或採用多組阻尼器，並在結構計算書中寫明所針對的模態編號與方向。~Dampers usually sit near the top where modal displacement peaks; if the problem is the second mode or torsion, re-evaluate the location or use several devices, and state the targeted mode number and direction in the structural calculations.

units.anchor: 擺錘質量塊與吊索~Pendulum mass and hangers
units.title: 擺錘頻率與懸吊幾何~Pendulum frequency and suspension geometry
units.mechanism: 大型阻尼器常做成單擺：質量塊由多組鋼索或鋼棒懸吊，擺動頻率只由有效擺長與重力加速度決定，與質量本身無關。這讓設計者能用擺長調頻，但低頻需要很長的擺長；當樓層高度不足時，可用多段折返擺、加裝水平彈簧或倒擺組合縮短實體高度。質量塊多以厚鋼板疊合，以便分件吊運並在現場組成。~Large dampers are often simple pendulums: the mass hangs from several sets of steel cables or rods, and the swing frequency depends only on the effective length and gravity, not on the mass. Designers can therefore tune by length, but low frequencies need long pendulums; when storey height is insufficient, folded multi-stage pendulums, horizontal springs or inverted-pendulum combinations shorten the physical height. The mass is usually built from stacked thick steel plates so it can be lifted in pieces and assembled on site.
units.model: 單擺 f = (1/2π)·√(g/L)，故 L = g/(2πf)²。目標頻率 0.139 Hz 時 L = 9.81/(2π×0.139)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m；若頻率改為 0.20 Hz，L 只需約 6.2 m。數值為教學假設。~For a simple pendulum f = (1/2π)·√(g/L), so L = g/(2πf)². A 0.139 Hz target gives L = 9.81/(2π×0.139)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m; a 0.20 Hz target needs only about 6.2 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以小振幅自由擺動量測擺錘週期（記錄至少 10 個週期取平均），換算有效擺長，並與吊點幾何與吊索伸長量計算比較；吊索張力以應變計或液壓千斤頂讀值確認各吊索受力均勻。~Measure the pendulum period from small free swings, averaging at least 10 cycles, convert to effective length, and compare with the hanger geometry and cable-stretch calculation; confirm equal hanger forces with strain gauges or hydraulic-jack readings.
units.failure: 吊索受力不均會讓質量塊傾斜並引入扭擺耦合，量到的頻率出現兩個相近峰值；若吊點連接或吊索端錨疲勞，長期擺動會造成鬆弛，頻率逐年漂移。~Unequal hanger forces tilt the mass and introduce torsional coupling, so the measured frequency shows two close peaks; fatigue at hanger connections or terminations lets long-term swinging cause slack and a frequency that drifts year by year.
units.misconception: 質量塊越重，擺錘的擺動頻率就越低。~The heavier the mass, the lower the pendulum frequency.
units.practice: 質量塊分件設計時，每一片的重量要配合塔吊在該半徑的額定荷重與樓板臨時支撐，組裝順序寫入施工計畫；吊索端錨與吊點須設計成可檢查與可更換。~When splitting the mass into pieces, size each plate to the tower-crane rating at that radius and to temporary slab shoring, write the assembly order into the construction plan, and make hanger terminations and pick points inspectable and replaceable.

units.anchor: 黏滯阻尼器與渦電流板~Viscous dampers and eddy-current plates
units.title: 耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流~Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current
units.mechanism: 擺錘只負責與結構反相運動，真正把能量變成熱的是連接擺錘與樓板的阻尼元件。油壓黏滯阻尼器讓矽油通過活塞孔口，阻尼力與速度的 α 次方成正比；渦電流阻尼器則讓磁鐵在銅板上方移動，感應電流產生與速度成正比的拖曳力，沒有流體密封，改變磁鐵與銅板的間隙即可調整阻尼。兩者都必須在極低速度與毫米級振幅下仍能作用。~The pendulum only moves out of phase with the structure; the damping device between the pendulum and the floor turns energy into heat. A hydraulic viscous damper forces silicone fluid through piston orifices, giving a force proportional to velocity raised to the power α; an eddy-current damper moves magnets over a copper plate so induced currents create a drag proportional to velocity, with no fluid seals and with damping adjusted by the magnet–plate gap. Both must work at very low velocities and millimetre amplitudes.
units.model: 最佳阻尼係數 c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d。取 m_d = 660,000 kg、ζ_d = 0.049、ω_d = 2π×0.139 = 0.873 rad/s，c_d = 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m；若擺錘速度 0.2 m/s，總阻尼力約 11.3 kN。數值為教學假設。~The optimum damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d. With m_d = 660,000 kg, ζ_d = 0.049 and ω_d = 2π×0.139 = 0.873 rad/s, c_d = 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m; at a pendulum velocity of 0.2 m/s the total damping force is about 11.3 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 阻尼器出廠前以試驗機做正弦力—速度試驗，涵蓋設計頻率附近多個振幅與溫度，繪出遲滯迴圈計算等效阻尼係數，與規格允差（例如 ±15%）比較；渦電流阻尼則量測不同間隙下的拖曳力曲線。~Before delivery, test each damper on a rig with sinusoidal force–velocity runs at several amplitudes and temperatures near the design frequency, compute the equivalent damping coefficient from the hysteresis loops and compare with the specified tolerance such as ±15%; for eddy-current units, measure drag curves at several gaps.
units.failure: 黏滯阻尼器密封老化漏油會使阻尼係數下降、擺錘過度擺動；摩擦過大的導軌或密封則讓微小振幅時阻尼器「卡住」，阻尼器變成附加質量，平常強風幾乎沒有減振效果。~Aged seals that leak oil reduce the damping coefficient and let the pendulum over-swing; excessive friction in guides or seals makes the damper stick at small amplitudes so it behaves like added mass and gives almost no reduction in ordinary strong winds.
units.misconception: 阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，減振效果一定越好。~The larger the damping coefficient, the better the vibration reduction.
units.practice: 採購規範要寫明低速啟動門檻、溫度範圍內的阻尼變化上限與耐久循環次數，並要求原型試驗與逐件試驗報告；渦電流方案需另檢查磁鐵固定與銅板散熱。~The procurement specification should state the low-velocity breakaway threshold, the maximum change of damping over the temperature range and the endurance cycles, and require prototype and production test reports; eddy-current designs also need checks on magnet retention and copper-plate heat dissipation.

units.anchor: 分層鋼板吊裝路徑~Plate-by-plate lifting route
units.title: 高空吊裝與分件組裝~High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly
units.mechanism: 數百公噸的質量塊無法一次吊上數百公尺高空，必須在結構封頂前把鋼板分件吊到預留樓層，再於臨時支撐上焊接或螺栓組成整體。吊裝期間樓板承受集中荷重，懸吊系統尚未受力，因此需要臨時支架承托質量塊；完成組裝後再逐步把荷重由臨時支架轉移到吊索，這個轉移過程決定了吊索初始張力是否均勻。~A mass of several hundred tonnes cannot be hoisted to several hundred metres in one lift, so steel plates are raised piece by piece to the reserved floors before the structure is topped out, then welded or bolted together on temporary supports. During this phase the slab carries concentrated loads while the suspension is not yet loaded, so temporary frames hold the mass; after assembly the load is transferred step by step from the frames to the hangers, and this transfer determines whether the initial hanger tensions are even.
units.model: 質量 660 t 分成 41 片時，平均每片約 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t；若塔吊在 30 m 半徑的額定荷重為 20 t，扣除吊具 1.5 t 後仍有約 2.4 t 餘裕。臨時支架若以 8 支柱承托，每支約 81 t。數值為教學假設。~Splitting 660 t into 41 plates gives about 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t each; with a 20 t tower-crane rating at 30 m radius and 1.5 t of rigging, about 2.4 t of margin remains. Eight temporary posts would each carry about 81 t. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 核對每一吊次的重量、半徑與塔吊荷重表，吊裝前由第三方確認吊具；荷重轉移時以液壓千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計同步記錄，並量測質量塊水平度與各支架卸載量。~Check each lift's weight and radius against the crane load chart and have rigging verified by a third party; during load transfer, record jack pressures and hanger strain gauges together and measure the block's levelness and the unloading of each frame.
units.failure: 若荷重轉移時某支吊索先受力，質量塊會傾斜並在吊點產生超過設計值的局部應力；臨時支架移除順序錯誤也可能造成樓板局部超載與裂縫。~If one hanger picks up load first during transfer, the block tilts and local stresses at its pick point exceed design values; removing temporary frames in the wrong order can locally overload and crack the slab.
units.misconception: 質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。~Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan.
units.practice: 施工計畫應包含吊次清單、樓板臨時支撐計算、荷重轉移的分級步驟與停止條件（例如任一吊索張力偏差超過 10% 即暫停調整），並由結構設計者簽認。~The construction plan should include a lift schedule, slab shoring calculations, staged load-transfer steps with hold points (for example pause and adjust if any hanger tension deviates by more than 10%), signed off by the structural designer.

units.anchor: 現場調頻機構~On-site tuning mechanism
units.title: 實測頻率與現場調頻~Measured frequency and on-site tuning
units.mechanism: 完工建築的實際頻率常與設計模型相差一到兩成，因為非結構牆、帷幕牆、混凝土實際勁度與質量分布都與假設不同；調諧質量阻尼器的最佳頻帶很窄，所以必須在結構與主要裝修完成後量測實際頻率，再調整擺長、彈簧勁度或附加質量，使阻尼器頻率落在最佳比值附近。調頻設計要預留雙向調整範圍。~The real frequency of a completed building often differs from the design model by ten to twenty percent, because partitions, the façade, actual concrete stiffness and mass distribution differ from the assumptions. A tuned mass damper has a narrow optimum band, so the actual frequency must be measured after the structure and major fit-out are complete, and the pendulum length, spring stiffness or added mass adjusted to place the damper frequency near the optimum ratio. The tuning hardware must allow adjustment in both directions.
units.model: Den Hartog 最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ)。μ = 0.0066 時 f_opt = 0.9934，結構實測 0.140 Hz 對應阻尼器 0.139 Hz。由 L ∝ 1/f²，頻率要降 5% 時擺長須增加 1/0.95² − 1 ≈ 10.8%。數值為教學假設。~The Den Hartog optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ). For μ = 0.0066, f_opt = 0.9934, so a measured 0.140 Hz building calls for a 0.139 Hz damper. Because L ∝ 1/f², lowering the frequency by 5% needs a length increase of 1/0.95² − 1 ≈ 10.8%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以環境振動量測取得結構實際頻率後，先鎖定擺錘量一次、再釋放擺錘量一次，確認雙峰位置大致對稱；調整後重新做自由衰減或強制振動試驗，記錄最終擺長與頻率比。~After ambient measurement of the actual building frequency, measure once with the pendulum locked and once released, confirming that the two peaks are roughly symmetric; after adjustment repeat a free-decay or forced-vibration test and record the final length and frequency ratio.
units.failure: 若以設計頻率直接製造而不預留調整，實際頻率偏離 5% 時，雙自由度模型顯示等效阻尼可能由約 3.7% 降到約 2.1%，加速度改善幅度明顯縮水。~Building to the design frequency without adjustment range means that a 5% offset in the actual frequency can drop the equivalent damping in the two-degree-of-freedom model from about 3.7% to about 2.1%, sharply shrinking the acceleration benefit.
units.misconception: 阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。~A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site.
units.practice: 把調頻機構（可調吊點、加減配重或彈簧）納入設計與合約範圍，並安排在帷幕牆與主要機電完成後的固定時程進行調頻驗收，必要時一年後再複核一次。~Include the tuning hardware (adjustable pick points, removable weights or springs) in the design and contract, schedule tuning acceptance after the façade and major services are complete, and re-check after about a year if needed.

units.anchor: 頂層加速度計陣列~Top-level accelerometer array
units.title: 環境振動量測與系統識別~Ambient vibration measurement and system identification
units.mechanism: 高樓在日常風與交通擾動下一直有微小振動，只要在頂部與阻尼器上放置高靈敏度加速度計長時間記錄，就能用頻域分解或峰值挑選法辨識模態頻率、振型與阻尼比。量測要同時涵蓋兩個水平方向與扭轉（至少兩個角落），並同步記錄風速風向，才能把阻尼比與振幅、風況關聯起來；超高層阻尼比往往隨振幅改變。~A tall building vibrates slightly all the time under everyday wind and traffic, so long records from sensitive accelerometers at the top and on the damper let engineers identify modal frequencies, shapes and damping ratios by frequency-domain decomposition or peak picking. Measurements must cover both horizontal directions and torsion (at least two corners) and be synchronised with wind speed and direction, so that damping can be related to amplitude and wind condition; damping in supertall towers often changes with amplitude.
units.model: 半功率頻寬法 ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n)。若共振峰 f_n = 0.140 Hz，半功率點 f₁ = 0.1383 Hz、f₂ = 0.1418 Hz，則 ζ ≈ 0.0035/0.280 ≈ 1.25%；頻率解析度需優於 0.0005 Hz，記錄長度至少約 1/0.0005 = 2,000 s。數值為教學假設。~The half-power bandwidth method gives ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n). With a peak at f_n = 0.140 Hz and half-power points at f₁ = 0.1383 Hz and f₂ = 0.1418 Hz, ζ ≈ 0.0035/0.280 ≈ 1.25%; resolving 0.0005 Hz needs a record of at least about 1/0.0005 = 2,000 s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比較兩種辨識方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間法）得到的頻率與阻尼，差異應在可解釋範圍內；感測器先在地面並排做相互比對，記錄方位與安裝位置照片，並把結果與有限元素模態比較。~Compare frequencies and damping from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and require explainable agreement; co-locate sensors on the ground first for a huddle test, record orientations and mounting photographs, and compare results with finite-element modes.
units.failure: 記錄太短或頻率解析度不足時，半功率頻寬被放大，算出的阻尼比偏高，讓人誤以為阻尼器表現良好；感測器方向裝反則會把兩個方向的模態混在一起。~Records that are too short or too coarse in frequency inflate the half-power bandwidth and overstate damping, suggesting the damper performs better than it does; a reversed sensor orientation mixes the modes of the two directions.
units.misconception: 只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。~Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption.
units.practice: 監測系統應包含時間同步、遠端資料傳輸與資料品質檢查（缺值、飽和、漂移），量測報告需附原始資料格式與處理參數，方便日後由他人重算。~The monitoring system should include time synchronisation, remote data transfer and data-quality checks (gaps, saturation, drift), and the report should attach the raw data format and processing parameters so others can recompute later.

units.anchor: 自由衰減與強制振動試驗~Free-decay and forced-vibration tests
units.title: 阻尼器整體性能驗證~Whole-system damper performance verification
units.mechanism: 零件試驗合格不代表裝在樓上的整套系統合格，因此完工後要做系統級驗證：可用千斤頂或纜線把擺錘拉離平衡位置後釋放，觀察擺錘與結構的自由衰減；也可用阻尼器自身或附加的作動器做強制振動掃頻。藉由比較鎖定與釋放擺錘時結構的衰減率或頻率響應，直接得到阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。~Passing component tests does not prove the installed system, so after completion a system-level verification is done: pull the pendulum off equilibrium with jacks or cables and release it to observe the free decay of the pendulum and structure, or use the damper itself or an added actuator for a forced-vibration sweep. Comparing structural decay or frequency response with the pendulum locked and released gives the added damping directly.
units.model: 對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ)，ζ ≈ δ/(2π)。若振幅由 100 mm 經 10 個週期降為 53 mm，δ = ln(100/53)/10 = 0.0635，ζ ≈ 1.0%；釋放擺錘後若 10 個週期降為 10 mm，δ = 0.230，ζ ≈ 3.7%。數值為教學假設。~The logarithmic decrement is δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ) with ζ ≈ δ/(2π). If amplitude falls from 100 mm to 53 mm in 10 cycles, δ = ln(100/53)/10 = 0.0635 and ζ ≈ 1.0%; if, with the pendulum released, it falls to 10 mm in 10 cycles, δ = 0.230 and ζ ≈ 3.7%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 事先寫好試驗計畫：初始拉離量、釋放方式、量測點、取樣率、允收準則（例如附加阻尼不低於設計值的 80%），並重複三次取平均；試驗時段選在低風速時，同步記錄風速以排除外力干擾。~Write the test plan beforehand: initial offset, release method, measurement points, sampling rate and acceptance criterion (for example added damping not below 80% of the design value), and repeat three times for an average; test in low wind and record wind speed simultaneously to exclude external forcing.
units.failure: 若在強風下做自由衰減，外力持續輸入會讓衰減曲線失真；擺錘若碰到緩衝器或導軌摩擦突然改變，衰減曲線會出現轉折，用單一 ζ 擬合就會得到錯誤結論。~Free decay in strong wind is distorted by continued forcing; if the pendulum touches a bumper or guide friction changes abruptly, the decay curve kinks, and fitting a single ζ gives the wrong conclusion.
units.misconception: 阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。~Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building.
units.practice: 系統試驗報告要記錄擺長、配重、阻尼器編號與溫度，作為之後每次維護後比對的基準；試驗前須確認行程限制器與安全鎖定可靠，並劃定人員禁入區。~The system test report should record pendulum length, weights, damper serial numbers and temperature as the baseline for every later maintenance comparison; before testing confirm stroke limiters and safety locks, and mark exclusion zones for personnel.

units.anchor: 緩衝環與行程限制器~Snubber ring and stroke limiters
units.title: 極端事件的行程限制與防撞~Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events
units.mechanism: 颱風或地震時，擺錘相對位移可能遠大於日常值；若不限制，質量塊會撞到結構或機電設備。因此大型阻尼器設有緩衝環、油壓緩衝器或非線性彈簧，在超過設計行程時逐漸吸收動能，把衝擊力分散到結構可承受的範圍。行程限制的設計是在減振效果與安全之間取捨：限制太早會削弱效果，太晚則衝擊力過大。~In a typhoon or earthquake the pendulum's relative displacement can far exceed everyday values; without limits the mass would hit the structure or services. Large dampers therefore have snubber rings, hydraulic buffers or nonlinear springs that progressively absorb kinetic energy beyond the design stroke, spreading the impact force to levels the structure can take. Stroke limiting trades vibration reduction against safety: limiting too early weakens performance, too late creates excessive impact force.
units.model: 擺錘以 0.6 m/s 撞到緩衝器時動能 E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ；若緩衝行程 0.3 m 且力量近似線性增加，峰值力 F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN。數值為教學假設。~If the pendulum reaches the buffer at 0.6 m/s, its kinetic energy is E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ; with 0.3 m of buffer travel and a roughly linear force rise, the peak force is F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入設計颱風與地震紀錄，檢查擺錘最大位移、接觸次數與緩衝力，並確認支撐緩衝器的樓板與構件強度；完工後確認實際淨距與緩衝器預壓符合圖說。~Run nonlinear time-history analyses with design typhoon and earthquake records to check maximum pendulum displacement, contact count and buffer forces, and verify the slab and members supporting the buffers; after completion confirm actual clearances and buffer preload against the drawings.
units.failure: 緩衝器設計不足時，極端事件中質量塊反覆撞擊會損壞阻尼器、吊索與周邊樓板；若擺錘在地震中與結構不同步大幅擺動，也可能對主結構造成不利的附加力。~Undersized buffers let the mass impact repeatedly in an extreme event, damaging the dampers, hangers and surrounding slab; if the pendulum swings out of sync during an earthquake it can also apply unfavourable additional forces to the main structure.
units.misconception: 阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。~A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response.
units.practice: 事件後檢查清單應包含緩衝器接觸痕跡、吊索與吊點、阻尼器漏油、擺錘水平度與鎖定裝置，並與事件時的監測資料比對，確認是否需要重新調頻或更換元件。~A post-event checklist should cover buffer contact marks, hangers and pick points, damper leaks, block levelness and locking devices, compared with the monitoring data from the event to decide whether retuning or component replacement is needed.

units.anchor: 監測與維護紀錄~Monitoring and maintenance records
units.title: 長期性能、維護與交接~Long-term performance, maintenance and handover
units.mechanism: 阻尼器設計壽命常與建築相同，但其性能會隨結構頻率改變、阻尼液老化、吊索鬆弛與溫度而漂移；建築改裝增加或移除大量質量，也會讓原本的調頻失準。因此交接文件必須包含設計參數、調頻紀錄、試驗基準、檢查週期與允收範圍，並把長期監測資料定期與基準比對，偏離時啟動重新調頻或維修。~A damper's design life often matches the building's, yet its performance drifts with changes in structural frequency, fluid ageing, hanger slack and temperature; renovations that add or remove large masses can also detune it. Handover documents must therefore contain design parameters, tuning records, test baselines, inspection intervals and acceptance ranges, and long-term monitoring data must be compared with the baseline periodically to trigger retuning or repair when they diverge.
units.model: 以 μ = 0.0066、結構阻尼 1% 的雙自由度模型計算，最佳調頻時共振放大係數由 50 降到約 13.6（等效阻尼約 3.7%）；頻率比偏離 ±5% 時放大係數回升到約 23，等效阻尼約 2.1%。數值為教學假設。~In a two-degree-of-freedom model with μ = 0.0066 and 1% structural damping, optimum tuning lowers the resonant amplification from 50 to about 13.6 (equivalent damping about 3.7%); a ±5% frequency-ratio offset raises it back to about 23, an equivalent damping of about 2.1%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每年由監測資料重新辨識結構與擺錘頻率，計算頻率比是否仍在允收範圍（例如偏離 2% 以內）；定期抽驗阻尼器力—速度特性與吊索張力，並把結果寫入維護資料庫與原始基準比較。~Each year re-identify structural and pendulum frequencies from monitoring data and check that the frequency ratio stays within the acceptance range (for example within 2%); periodically spot-check damper force–velocity behaviour and hanger tension, and enter the results into a maintenance database for comparison with the original baseline.
units.failure: 若交接時沒有留下調頻基準與試驗紀錄，多年後即使阻尼器已失準，管理單位也無法判斷，只能等住戶抱怨；大規模改裝未通知結構顧問，也可能使阻尼器在不知情下失效。~Without tuning baselines and test records at handover, a damper can drift out of tune for years before anyone can tell, until occupants complain; major renovations made without notifying the structural consultant can silently defeat the damper.
units.misconception: 阻尼器是被動裝置，裝好之後就不需要維護與監測。~A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含操作與維護手冊、緊急鎖定程序、事件後檢查表、監測資料格式與聯絡窗口；大樓重大改裝或使用變更前，須由結構顧問評估對阻尼器調頻的影響。~Handover should include the operation and maintenance manual, emergency locking procedure, post-event checklist, monitoring data format and contacts; before major renovation or change of use, the structural consultant must assess the effect on damper tuning.

example: 設計練習：某超高層第一模態 f₁ = 0.140 Hz、結構阻尼 ζ_s = 1%、頂部廣義質量 M* = 100,000 t，選用 m_d = 660 t 擺錘。質量比 μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066；最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ) = 0.9934，阻尼器頻率 f_d = 0.140×0.9934 ≈ 0.139 Hz；最佳阻尼比 ζ_d = √[3μ/(8(1+μ)³)] = √[0.0198/8.159] ≈ 0.049；擺長 L = g/(2πf_d)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m；阻尼係數 c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d ≈ 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m。以雙自由度模型掃頻，共振放大由 1/(2×0.01) = 50 降到約 13.6，相當於等效阻尼約 3.7%，風致加速度約降為原來的 √(1%/3.7%) ≈ 52%。若頻率偏離 5%，等效阻尼只剩約 2.1%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Design exercise: a supertall tower has f₁ = 0.140 Hz, structural damping ζ_s = 1% and a top generalised mass M* = 100,000 t, and a 660 t pendulum is chosen. The mass ratio is μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066; the optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ) = 0.9934, so f_d = 0.140×0.9934 ≈ 0.139 Hz; the optimum damping ratio is ζ_d = √[3μ/(8(1+μ)³)] = √[0.0198/8.159] ≈ 0.049; the pendulum length is L = g/(2πf_d)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m; the damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d ≈ 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m. A two-degree-of-freedom sweep lowers the resonant amplification from 1/(2×0.01) = 50 to about 13.6, equivalent to about 3.7% damping, so wind-induced acceleration falls to roughly √(1%/3.7%) ≈ 52% of the original. A 5% frequency offset leaves only about 2.1% equivalent damping. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: Hermann Frahm 於 1909 年提出以附加質量抑制振動的構想並取得專利，Ormondroyd 與 Den Hartog 在 1928 年建立阻尼吸振器理論，Den Hartog 的教科書使最佳調頻與阻尼公式成為工程常識。1970 年代末紐約花旗集團中心與波士頓約翰漢考克大樓率先在高樓裝設調諧質量阻尼器；2004 年完工的台北 101 把巨大鋼球擺錘公開展示，2010 年代的上海中心大廈則採用以磁鐵與銅板產生阻尼的渦電流擺錘。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Hermann Frahm proposed damping vibration with an added mass and patented the idea from 1909, Ormondroyd and Den Hartog developed damped vibration-absorber theory in 1928, and Den Hartog's textbook made the optimum tuning and damping formulas engineering common knowledge. In the late 1970s Citicorp Center in New York and the John Hancock Tower in Boston were early tall buildings with tuned mass dampers; Taipei 101, completed in 2004, put its giant steel-sphere pendulum on public display, and Shanghai Tower in the 2010s used a pendulum damped by magnets moving over copper plates. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 台北 101 塔內擺錘約 660 公噸（設計顧問頁列為 600 公噸級），塔尖另有兩組約 4.5 公噸的阻尼器~Taipei 101's tower pendulum is about 660 t (listed as 600 t class by its damper designer), with two pinnacle dampers of about 4.5 t each
台北 101 擺錘由鋼板疊合成直徑約 5.5 m 的球體，懸吊於約 87 至 92 樓之間~Taipei 101's pendulum is a sphere about 5.5 m in diameter built from stacked steel plates, hung between roughly levels 87 and 92
上海中心大廈的擺錘約 1,000 公噸，以約 1,800 顆釹鐵硼磁鐵在銅板上方產生渦電流阻尼~Shanghai Tower's pendulum is about 1,000 t, damped by about 1,800 NdFeB magnets moving over a copper plate
上海中心大廈阻尼器設計者公開說明，強風時建築加速度可降低約 45%~The Shanghai Tower damper designer reports about a 45% reduction in building acceleration in strong winds
常見超高層阻尼器質量比約在 0.5% 至 2% 之間，取決於模態廣義質量與可用空間~Typical supertall damper mass ratios lie between about 0.5% and 2%, depending on modal generalised mass and available space
Den Hartog 最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ)，μ = 1% 時約 0.990~The Den Hartog optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ), about 0.990 for μ = 1%
μ = 1% 時最佳阻尼比 ζ_opt = √[3μ/(8(1+μ)³)] ≈ 6.0%~For μ = 1% the optimum damping ratio ζ_opt = √[3μ/(8(1+μ)³)] ≈ 6.0%
0.14 Hz 的單擺需要約 12.7 m 的有效擺長~A 0.14 Hz simple pendulum needs an effective length of about 12.7 m
